description: Example National Road Database is a series of datasets listed in Opendataumea open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Municipality of Umeå. If you want information about roads and railways in the municipality, you can find it via the Swedish Transport Administration (Trafikverket). Trafikverket’s open data contains a wide range of information about roads and railways. This dataset contains information about wildlife fences in the municipality. Coverage: Umeå. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are wildlife fence, National Road database. The portal shows 172 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-umea-se-portal.
